messages.content: This project contains an adjustable jig: two opposing yokes, their protective shields and adjustment knobs, on a fixed base. Two sample objects stand nearby.

Open the gap between the yokes by 46 cm, equally on both sides. Take their shields and adjustment knobs with them, keeping the existing offsets. Keep the base and the two sample objects where they are.

Coordinated 10 components in 2 shared edit sets; identities and construction recipes retained. Linked components followed their hosts once.
Yoke 1 and Yoke 2: center distance 1.9 m. World-envelope gaps X/Y/Z: 1.72 / 0 / 0 m (bounding-envelope distances, not nearest surface distance). Shared solid volume 0 m³.
